high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the Hindustan Times website. The article appears to be discussing a letter sent by lawmakers to President Biden regarding the Taliban's takeover of Afghanistan. The text in the article mentions that the lawmakers asked about the Taliban's de facto command and control over Afghan security forces' former personnel, equipment, and infrastructure. They also inquired about the Taliban's possession of an air force through this control and what plans the US has to disable any air forces operating under Taliban orders.
